note: Route A with Pressure for Help (Keel S25; Sky Q4), fight it out: Pressure leans on Inez's affair, learned by Listen ($0, +3 T); the cast's Inez is Fearful, so it is also her own approach and one order turns her, and she calls the guard at about 1:25. Pressed, she warns him (engine 0.38.0): he reaches her at about 2:21, stays 5 s and runs back at 2.2 m/s, on his door at about 3:02, so the door is clear for about 1:37 of the call, not the walk both ways a helped Inez buys. No Reroute (brief 067 A). This script sends the Enforcer to the door from 2:40: in at about 2:42, about 20 s before the guard is back, and out at about 3:20, after the crew has posted; he holds Vale at (20.0, -65.0) as route-a does while the three break the crew, then boards; the car leaves at once and the three walk out. The 2:40 is this script's, not the route's: played across seeds at a person's pace, going at once wins more than going 80 s after the call, when the guard is often back first (briefs/085/motive/probe/plans press-late0, press-late80). Slower than route-a (Go at about 4:19 against 3:41) because it waits for the posts, at 2 T more (6 against 4) and no money (route-a pays $40,000).
